description: This file is a Python script responsible for managing vendor snapshot installation, including fetching build artifacts, unzipping or creating symlinks, generating Android.bp files for different architectures, and analyzing module usage via Ninja build inputs. It also includes utilities for parsing JSON module descriptions and converting them into build configurations, as well as handling license information. The script supports command-line arguments for controlling its behavior, such as specifying the snapshot version, image type, build details, and various options for installation and analysis.
